mapper.sql: mn.id, mn.Opm_Id, mn.Opl_Parent_Id, mn.Opl_Name, mn.Opl_Code, mn.Opl_Remark, mn.Opl_Status, mn.Opl_Sort, mn.Opl_Content, mn.Opl_Bussnis, mn.Opn_Content, mn.Create_Time, mn.Create_Uid, mn.Create_Uname, mn.Opl_Score
mn.id, mn.Opm_Id, mn.Opl_Parent_Id, mn.Opl_Name, mn.Opl_Code, mn.Opl_Remark, mn.Opl_Status, mn.Opl_Sort, mn.Opl_Bussnis, mn.Create_Time, mn.Create_Uid, mn.Create_Uname, mn.Opl_Score
mapper.select:
select
,
,
ifnull(opt_count.tempcount, 0) as tempcount, ifnull(opr_count.riskcount, 0) as riskcount, ifnull(opd_count.datasourcecount, 0) as datasourcecount, if(mn.Opl_Content is null or length(mn.Opl_Content) = 0, 1, 0) as isEmpty from Outline_Project_Lib mn left join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id left join (select mn.id as Opl_Id, count(*) as tempcount from Outline_Project_Lib mn join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id join Outline_Project_Temp opt on opt.Opl_Id = mn.id join SYS_File sf on sf.FileProject = opm.P_Id and sf.T_Code = opt.T_Code where sf.FileFlowStatus != 3 group by mn.id) opt_count on opt_count.Opl_Id = mn.id left join (select mn.id as Opl_Id, count(*) as riskcount from Outline_Project_Lib mn join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id join Outline_Project_Risk opr on opr.Opl_Id = mn.id join Risk_Warn rw on rw.Rwi_Id = opr.Risk_Id and rw.P_Id = opm.P_Id group by mn.id) opr_count on opr_count.Opl_Id = mn.id left join (select Opl_Id, count(1) as datasourcecount from outline_projec_datasource group by Opl_Id) opd_count on opd_count.Opl_Id = mn.id
and mn.Opm_Id = #{params.opmId}
AND mn.Opl_Content LIKE '%' || #{params.oplContent} || '%'
AND mn.Opl_Name LIKE '%' || #{params.oplName} || '%'
AND ((mn.Opl_Content LIKE '%' || #{params.oplContent} || '%') OR (mn.Opl_Name LIKE '%' || #{params.oplName} || '%'))
AND mn.Opl_Name = #{params.oplNameExact}
AND opm.Opm_Code = #{params.opmCode}
order by mn.Opl_Sort

select , ifnull(opt_count.tempcount, 0) as tempcount, ifnull(opr_count.riskcount, 0) as riskcount, ifnull(opd_count.datasourcecount, 0) as datasourcecount, if(mn.Opl_Content is null or length(mn.Opl_Content) = 0, 1, 0) as isEmpty from outline_project_lib mn left join (select mn.id as Opl_Id, count(1) as tempcount from Outline_Project_Lib mn join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id join Outline_Project_Temp opt on opt.Opl_Id = mn.id join SYS_File sf on sf.FileProject = opm.P_Id and sf.T_Code = opt.T_Code where sf.FileFlowStatus != 3 group by mn.id) opt_count on opt_count.Opl_Id = mn.id left join (select mn.id as Opl_Id, count(1) as riskcount from Outline_Project_Lib mn join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id join Outline_Project_Risk opr on opr.Opl_Id = mn.id join Risk_Warn rw on rw.Rwi_Id = opr.Risk_Id and rw.P_Id = opm.P_Id group by mn.id) opr_count on opr_count.Opl_Id = mn.id left join (select Opl_Id, count(1) as datasourcecount from outline_projec_datasource group by Opl_Id) opd_count on opd_count.Opl_Id = mn.id where mn.Opm_Id = #{opmId}

select mn.id from outline_project_lib mn where mn.Opm_Id = #{opmId} and (mn.Opl_Content is null or length(mn.Opl_Content) = 0) and not EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM outline_project_lib child WHERE child.Opl_Parent_Id = mn.id)

select , opt.T_Code, ifnull(opr_count.riskcount, 0) as riskcount from outline_project_lib mn left join Outline_Project_Temp opt on opt.Opl_Id = mn.id left join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id left join (select mn.id as Opl_Id, count(1) as riskcount from Outline_Project_Lib mn join Outline_Project_Manage opm on mn.Opm_Id = opm.id join Outline_Project_Risk opr on opr.Opl_Id = mn.id join Risk_Warn rw on rw.Rwi_Id = opr.Risk_Id and rw.P_Id = opm.P_Id group by mn.id) opr_count on opr_count.Opl_Id = mn.id where opm.id in
